mandatoryClauses.name: Consumer Status
mandatoryClauses.description: Establish that complainant is a 'consumer' within meaning of S.2(7) Consumer Protection Act, 2019

mandatoryClauses.name: Deficiency in Service / Defect in Goods
mandatoryClauses.description: Specific details of deficiency in service or defect in goods

mandatoryClauses.name: Consideration Paid
mandatoryClauses.description: Amount paid for goods/services, date, mode of payment, receipt/invoice details

mandatoryClauses.name: Prior Grievance Attempts
mandatoryClauses.description: Prior attempts to resolve the grievance with the opposite party

mandatoryClauses.name: Territorial Jurisdiction
mandatoryClauses.description: Basis for filing before this particular forum

mandatoryClauses.name: Pecuniary Jurisdiction
mandatoryClauses.description: Total claim amount falls within the forum's pecuniary jurisdiction

mandatoryClauses.name: Limitation
mandatoryClauses.description: Complaint filed within 2 years of cause of action (S.69 CPA 2019)

mandatoryClauses.name: Prayer Clause
mandatoryClauses.description: Specific reliefs sought — refund, replacement, compensation, costs

mandatoryClauses.name: Advocate Details
mandatoryClauses.description: Name and enrollment number of advocate

verificationTemplate:
VERIFICATION

I, {applicant}, {relation} of {parentName}, aged about {age} years, resident of {address}, do hereby verify that the contents of paragraphs 1 to {lastParagraph} of the above complaint are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. No part of it is false and nothing material has been concealed therein.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

Deponent
filingChecklist: Complaint (original + copies for each opposite party + 1 for office)
Correspondence with opposite party (complaints, emails, letters)
Photographs / videos of defective goods (if applicable)
Proof of payment (bank statement, UPI screenshot)
Court fee as per state rules
promptInstructions: Draft a Consumer Complaint under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
Establish the complainant's status as a 'consumer' under Section 2(7) CPA 2019.
Describe the deficiency in service or defect in goods with specific dates, amounts, and particulars.
State the consideration paid — amount, date, mode of payment, invoice/receipt details.
Describe prior attempts to resolve the grievance with the opposite party.
Establish territorial jurisdiction — where the opposite party resides/carries on business OR where the cause of action arose.
Establish pecuniary jurisdiction: District Commission (up to Rs.1 crore), State Commission (Rs.1-10 crore), National Commission (above Rs.10 crore).
State that the complaint is within limitation (2 years from cause of action under S.69).
Reference unfair trade practice or restrictive trade practice if applicable.
Do NOT generate the verification clause or advocate signature block — those are added programmatically.
